purpose: Define the point at which System 3 is mature enough that the remaining major uncertainty is an unrevealed prospectively governed physical/stability result rather than an unfrozen method choice.
analogy_only: L15 is an internal maturity analogy to the CO/Cu prospective production gate, not a shared scientific mechanism or result.
required_upstream_readiness: QUANTUM_READY when a full rate comparison is attempted
DISSIPATION_READY before any chi or ChemSA stability interpretation
required_tooling_freeze: domain terminology takes precedence over project-specific language
scalar, modal/vector, and conglomeration/system-level outputs remain distinct
chi is computed only from a licensed derivation for the matched coordinate and state point
boundary/regime/phase terminology is inherited from the governing science
uncertainty and provenance accompany every promoted coordinate
held-out experimental or literature outcomes cannot select upstream settings
required_manuscript_state: methods and acceptance rules written before the result they govern
current evidence status explicitly separated from pending sections
result placeholders cannot be promoted by narrative alone
no universality claim is under adjudication
negative and HOLD outcomes have prewritten interpretation language
required_package_state: parent ChemSA release remains inheritance-locked and System 3 is additive
failure_policy: Any failed independent prerequisite remains HOLD. Conflicting gates are investigated and never averaged to PASS.
